image_description: A blue Massey Ferguson tractor is shown in profile, driving through a muddy field. Attached to the rear of the tractor is a silver/grey agricultural implement, which appears to be a plow or cultivator with multiple tines/shares digging into the soil. The background features rural buildings and trees under an overcast sky.
